column1: # The union families of the registry whose instances rest on per-leg hand assertions

# calls name no shared source of the answer (a corpus or testdata file, the reference
# engine, an oracle, a golden, the conformance harness) is hand-asserted, marked *.
# basis: hand = every case's legs are hand-asserted; mixed = some are.
